$description: Layout tokens for NCSSM YAC slides on the Claude Design 1920 x 1080 canvas, taken from the decks.

padding.usage: Margin on every side. Leaves 1664 x 824 inside.

padding-with-footer.usage: Use when the slide has a footer.

footer.usage: Right-aligned presenter first name with a 56px profile picture or initials circle to its left, pinned. No slide numbers.

md.usage: Dot to eyebrow; inside cards; between cards in a 5-up row.

lg.usage: Between cards and columns; cover block gaps.

xl.usage: Between title and content on dense slides.

3xl.usage: Between a text column and a chart or image.

4xl.usage: Title to content on sparse slides.

card-ruled.usage: Cards with a 6px top rule: square top, round bottom.

accent.usage: Top rule on cards and agenda columns; left rule on announcement items. Orange for the current or featured item, Blue for the rest.

card.usage: Outlined white cards and chart panels.

placeholder.usage: Frames still waiting for a photo or someone's copy.

cover-rule.usage: Top border of the cover's bottom block.

light.usage: Orange dot before an eyebrow on Paper.

dark.usage: Orange dot before an eyebrow on Blue.
